issues.problem: The exemplar says the side opposite the 40° angle (at the top of the mast) is the mast height h. That is wrong. The side opposite the 40° angle is the 40 m horizontal ground distance, and h is adjacent to the 40° angle (and opposite the 50° angle). So sin 40° = 40 ÷ hypotenuse and cos 50° = 40 ÷ hypotenuse, not h ÷ hypotenuse. The conclusion sin 40° = cos 50° = 0.6428 is correct, but the reasoning given is wrong.

Lesson 7 gives two different values for the dhow below the coastal cliff: about 28.6 m in the teacher demonstration and about 31.1 m in the group-problem results. It also says the Kisumu building problem was only the extension, yet it lists the Nairobi flagpole and the coastal cliff as the presented problems. The dhow distance cannot be both 28.6 m and 31.1 m for the same situation, so no Final Explanation can agree with both values.
